verses.4:72: وَإِنَّ مِنكُمۡ لَمَن لَّيُبَطِّئَنَّ فَإِنۡ أَصَٰبَتۡكُم مُّصِيبَةࣱ قَالَ قَدۡ أَنۡعَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيَّ إِذۡ لَمۡ أَكُن مَّعَهُمۡ شَهِيدࣰ ا

meaning: The root بطأ (bTA) describes something that is slow. The form أَبْطَأُ means "more" or "most slow," indicating a comparative or superlative degree of slowness.
en_note: Manually curated for a Quranic hapax root.
